text:
fiona: Quick postmortem follow-up. Need final status copy + customer summary + a clear RCA-access playbook. Legal flagged sensitive traces in our internal logs. Can we assign owners and deadlines?

max: I can draft the status blurb now. Will keep it short and plain.

reema: I'll own the customer-facing summary and a short FAQ. Proposal: public service update + "deep-dive" available on request for impacted enterprise customers. Deep-dive requires CSM handshake + consent.

owen: Ops: recurring symptom here is eviction storms in the model cache; saw a similar signature in 5 incidents last quarter. Need a remediation ticket, ownership, and a detection alert. I'll open INF-5011 and add acceptance criteria.

legal: Legal guidance: call public posts a "service update" or "technical summary". Do NOT publish raw request contents, internal IPs, or unredacted traces. For any internal logs shared with customers, require a signed consent form; we'll provide a redaction checklist.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-599 0assigned to @fiona

fiona: Max, paste your status text here. Reema, can you target Tue EOD for the customer email draft? Owen, can you create the remediation ticket today and add ETA?

max: Draft status update: 
```
Status: Partial degradation of text-generation API.
Impact: elevated latencies and intermittent errors for a subset of requests between 09:08-09:35 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated after rollback; monitoring.
Next steps: We will publish a technical summary on the status page and share a customer-facing note by <date>.
```
Thoughts?

reema: Looks fine. Add: "Data integrity: no customer data was changed or lost." I'll draft the email + a one-question consent checkbox: "I agree to receive a redacted internal report about this incident (requires consent form/NDA)."

fiona: Decision: public technical summary on status page + offer expanded internal report to impacted enterprise customers on request. Require CSM confirmation and signed consent/NDA before any logs/traces leave Redwood. Owners: max (status copy), reema (customer summary & consent language), owen (remediation ticket). Deadlines: status now, customer summary Tue EOD, remediation ticket today.

owen: Created INF-5011 "model-cache eviction: guardrails + alerting" (owner: owen). ETA: 3w. Acceptance criteria: (1) detection alert triggers after >3 eviction spikes in 10m, (2) runbook with mitigation steps, (3) automated throttle reduces eviction frequency in load tests.

reema: I'll post the customer email + FAQ + consent wording by Tue EOD. Sample FAQ entry: "How can I request more details?" -> Contact your CSM; they'll coordinate consent and delivery of a redacted report.

legal: We'll share the redaction checklist and a short consent template. Quick note: avoid internal timestamps/hostnames in shared docs; sanitize log snippets to remove identifying tokens.

cs-lead: CS will proactively contact top-affected customers. I'll share an outreach tracker with owners and dates by Wed.

fiona: Async review tomorrow 10:30am PT for drafts. Final action list captured here: - Statuspage technical summary (owner: max)  posted - Customer-facing email + FAQ + consent copy (owner: reema)  Tue EOD - Consent template & redaction checklist (owner: legal)  tomorrow - Remediation ticket + detection rule (owner: owen)  INF-5011 created, ETA 3w - CS proactive outreach tracker (owner: cs-lead)  Wed

max: ack :thumbsup:

reema: ack  will post drafts here.

owen: ack  linking INF-5011 to the postmortem.

fiona: Thanks all. I'll update the incident board and move comms card to In Progress. If Legal posts edits, please drop them in-thread so we can iterate before pushing to staging.
